task.pr_title: Closes #12988: Introduce custom field choice sets

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
This does not account for Windows users who get CRLF instead of just LF.

```suggestion
        return self.cleaned_data['extra_choices'].replace('\r\n','\n').split('\n')
```

evidence.attached_diff_hunk:

             self.fields['type'].disabled = True
 
 
+class CustomFieldChoiceSetForm(BootstrapMixin, forms.ModelForm):

evidence.thread_resolution: jeremystretch: This should use `splitlines()` to catch both cases.
